sampling: Reuse original fixed seed20261030 150000 sample-indices, no seed search; original legacy alignment/global reward inference

qualification.support: No bilateral-support requirement. Log actual forces, flight, foot motion, contact slip and undesired contacts.
qualification.notes: Review actual behavior, not reward names. Candidate failure does not exclude whole family. No qPD smoothing/PD change; record full command and actual response.

motion: At most three existing natural6s walk windows from fixed geometry audit; native backward_map sequence, no online privileged z optimization or new WBC.
training: Only after real feedback and legal execution effective. Fix development/held-out conditions before any training. M8PZ base and old regressions retained.
stop: Resource exceed, actual fall/nonfoot-ground/actual joint violation, incompatible asset, or core architecture gap. Preserve partial trajectory and assess bounded independent alternatives; never pretend a safety event passed.
